# NeuroTechX

> NeuroTechX is a volunteer-led non-profit and the international community for neurotechnology. It connects students, researchers, engineers and companies through local city chapters, university student clubs, events, education and open-source projects. Founded in Montréal in 2015; legally Société BCI Montréal, a Quebec non-profit (NEQ 1170984166). The official website is https://neurotechx.org (the old neurotechx.com site is retired).

## Join and connect

- [Community: chapters and Slack](https://neurotechx.org/community): local city chapters worldwide and how to join the NeuroTechX Slack
- [Join the Slack](https://neurotechx.org/slack): invitation to the community workspace
- [Student clubs](https://neurotechx.org/students): university neurotechnology clubs connected with NeuroTechX
- [Start a student club](https://neurotechx.org/students/start-a-club): guide to starting and running a club, and how to get listed
- [Newsletter](https://neurotechx.org/newsletter): the NeuroTechX newsletter and how to subscribe
- [Volunteer](https://neurotechx.org/join-the-team): open volunteer roles

## Opportunities

- [Events](https://neurotechx.org/events): neurotech, BCI and neuroscience conferences and hackathons
- [Jobs](https://neurotechx.org/jobs): neurotechnology job listings, updated from company job boards
- [Funding](https://neurotechx.org/funding): grants, fellowships, awards and start-up programmes for neurotech

## Learn

- [Education](https://neurotechx.org/education): courses, programmes and learning resources
- [The NeuroTech Primer](https://neurotechx.org/primer): beginner's guide to neurotechnology written by the community
- [Content Lab](https://neurotechx.org/content-lab): original articles on neurotechnology
- [Industry intelligence](https://neurotechx.org/reports): who to read on the neurotech industry, and industry news
- [Ecosystem directory](https://neurotechx.org/ecosystem): neurotech companies and academic labs

## Build

- [Open-source projects](https://neurotechx.org/projects): BCI benchmarks, EEG and neuroimaging toolkits, community repositories
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NeuroTechX): NeuroTechX code
